reviews.text: Have open ended

reviews.title: Randomly stops working
reviews.text: It just randomly stops working.  I’ve tried reinstalling and rebooting.  Nothing works

reviews.title: Benutzung nur online möglich
reviews.text: Leider funktioniert die App nur im online Betrieb! Die Nutzung als Meditationsapp ist daher eigentlich sinnlos, da ich während der Meditation offline sein möchte, um nicht gestört zu werden. Ich benutze sie hauptsächlich als Timer, weil ich den Klang sehr schön finde.

reviews.title: Not working anymore
reviews.text: This app was great until it stopped working. Nothing happens when I press start anymore. Can't submit a bug report because it says "there's a bug in the bug report...better go meditate," which is ironic given that app isn't working.

reviews.title: Lame
reviews.text: Doesn’t work with screen off. Doesn’t work if your screen goes on sleep.

reviews.title: So close but big problem
reviews.text: I was looking for an app that is exactly this, except there’s a big problem that I just can’t overcome. The background music/sounds aren’t seamlessly connected. It’s just a looping sound that fades in and out after the short snippet. Knowing the loop is there kills it for me. If you can overcome that, it’s the perfect app.

reviews.title: Broken after updating
reviews.text: Broken after updating lost settings

reviews.title: Didn’t work right
reviews.text: I like the concept but once my phone screen would go dark the end bell would never ring

reviews.title: Good before
reviews.text: This timer was great before, however now it often takes a while for the "gong" to respond. Sporatically it will not respond to a tap to start, then suddenly registers all the taps. Probably an easy fix in ur code somewhere.

reviews.title: Loved BEFORE recent update
reviews.text: This was amazing before this recent update. Before if I had set timer for a half hour and I’d only meditate for 20 minutes and would turn it off, it would show me in the stats that I meditated for 22 minutes. It now shows 30 minutes so it doesn’t save accurate stats. Sometimes when I hit the gong to start the timer,  it gongs, but then the timer never really starts and it doesn’t give me credit for the meditation. The new look of the time is awful. I like the old look better. So I’m looking for a new meditation app for my phone.

reviews.title: Was great, now less so
reviews.text: I have used this app for many years. Since the recent update, it no longer saves your settings (meditation time, gong sounds, etc).

reviews.title: Weniger ist mehr
reviews.text: Vor dem Update wunderbar, danach immer wieder aufs Neue alle Grundeinstellungen einstellen, App schaltet sich selber ab: Licht geht aus Ton wird nicht ausgespielt, bitte fixen

reviews.title: Since they changed up the app, it is nothing but annoying
reviews.text: Allegedly they cleared up glitches; I never heard/found any glitches UNTIL the change.  Now, my second favorite, they removed my favorite, Rain in the Forest, glitches all the time-momentary pauses that destroy concentration.  Also, every night I have to set Rain to play as it ALWAYS defaults to Waves in Coral Beach.  This app is now so annoying, I’m trying to find something else.  Developers:  Either FIX it or I’m gone.

reviews.title: Got worse
reviews.text: They took away the ability to easily increase or decrease the amount of time. The slider is not precise. Please add the plus and minus buttons back

reviews.title: Letztes Update
reviews.text: Nach dem letzten Update funktionieren die geführten Meditationen nicht mehr wie früher. Sie sind leiser und wenn das iPhone gesperrt wird, gehen Sie aus. Außerdem wird das iPhone sehr heiß. Warum hat man das geändert? Bitte den alten Zustand wiederherstellen.

reviews.title: Settings never save anymore
reviews.text: The app has always worked quite well, apart from not being able to lock the screen whilst in use. However, the recent most update has made it so annoyingly bad! My settings are NEVER saved, and I ALWAYS have to set my sounds and timer from scratch every single time. There is no need for such a dumb step backwards!

reviews.title: Settings not saving
reviews.text: Since the last update my settings for my meditations are not saving anymore. I have to set the duration and interval every time. I miss that.

reviews.title: Update NOT an improvement
reviews.text: I’ve used this meditation timer for years and loved it…until the recent update. Now I have to reset the meditation time and sounds for each session, the quality of the background sounds has seriously degraded, and my meditation history has disappeared. I am so disappointed with the recent changes, I will likely look for a new timer app unless the issues caused by the “improvement” are reversed.

reviews.title: Now Has Audio Looping Issues
reviews.text:
This was a great little no-fuss meditation app. Unfortunately, since the latest (v5) release, all of the background audio pauses for about a second each time it loops.
May not sound much, but these frequent disruptions make it really hard to concentrate, which makes the app near useless for meditation ☹️
Hopefully they’ll fix this soon.

reviews.title: Einstellung speichern
reviews.text:
Leider lässt sich die gewählte Einstellung nicht mehr speichern, so dass jedes Mal alles wieder neu eingegeben muss. 
Davor uneingeschränkt 5 Sterne, aber jetzt leider nicht mehr zufriedenstellend

reviews.title: Ok but settings don’t save
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app for a while and really liked it. However, the latest update no longer saves your settings, so you need to reset each time, and the background I use now has a jump on it when it starts repeating. I have now deleted the app. A shame.

reviews.title: End Gong did not sound with phone screen locked
reviews.text:
I'm on iOS 17.5.1. Latest version of the app.  Gong did not sound after meditation time elapsed. Only sounded gong when I unlocked phone screen. Was meant to be 1 hour but last session shows up in stats as longer than 60 minutes (62 minutes in this case).

Effectively pointless in its current state but thanks for trying.
